title: Manager Coach: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Maintenance had no return-to-service checklist, so a skipped leak test went unseen.

items.lesson: Return to service relied on memory, not a checklist.
items.explanation: The procedure index has no return-to-service entry [EVD-0002].

items.text: Stores buys the seals that maintenance fits; agree who approves a substitute part [FND-0003].

items.change: Add a signed leak-test hold point to every return to service
items.indicator: % of restarts with a signed leak-test record
items.why_not_stronger: A start interlock on a test record needs a control-system change; the hold point is the first step.

items.name: Restarts with a test record
items.measure: % of pump restarts in the CMMS with a leak-test record attached

rows: Check whether restarts still happen without a test record
Draft the checklist with the fitters

items.lesson: The seal-change job plan had no test step for the planner to schedule.
items.explanation: The work order shows no test [EVD-0001].

items.change: Add a leak-test step to every pressure-boundary job plan template
items.indicator: % of pressure-boundary job plans with a test step
items.why_not_stronger: Job plan templates are the planning function's own control; an interlock sits with maintenance.
